label: a_sch_class2g_eve01
text: We’re doing some test prep by helping each\nother study the subjects we’re good at!

label: a_sch_class2g_eve02
text: It’s more nerve-racking waiting for test results\nthan it is actually taking the test...

label: a_sch_class2g_eve03
text: I’m just taking a break, enjoying the view...\nMaybe I should start my Treasure Hunt soon!

label: a_sch_class2g_eve05
text: Doesn’t the son of some famous professor also\ncome to this academy? I bet he’s really smart...

label: a_sch_class2g_eve06
text: I’m suddenly in a picnic kinda mood! Wanna look\nfor a nice place outside the city?

label: a_sch_class2g_ni01
text: Learning is fun no matter how old you get.\nIt’s never too late to learn something new!
